verdict.rationale: Stable documents self-serve forwarding as a built-in mail action: 'Ship: Forward anywhere in the world, discounted rates included', 'forward packages', and 'ship' listed among basic mail actions on the pricing page. That supports operator-initiated forwarding without emailing support. The keyword auto-routing claim covers routing mail to internal teams, not physical forwarding rules, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: rule-based or automatic forwarding, saved forwarding recipients/addresses, carrier choice, cost shown before confirming, and any first-party workflow docs or hands-on corroboration of the forwarding flow.
